highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands image-filter, overdraw, and paint-bounds APIs.
highlights_body: It also restores fast small-sigma raster blurs, makes repeated surface canvas access nearly free, and refreshes HarfBuzz shaping fixes. This release completes the v4 obsolete-API transition and removes the deprecated .NET Interactive integration, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now fail compilation
breaking.body: Remaining warning-only pre-v4 APIs are now error-obsolete, including legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors, run-buffer span methods, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality. Use the constructors without sampleCount, the Glyphs or Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. The obsolete enums are also absent from the reference assembly.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive integration removed
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp NuGet package no longer includes SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive or its Polyglot Notebook renderers because .NET Interactive is deprecated upstream. Consumers relying on the embedded extension must remove that integration or provide their own notebook rendering support.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support across Tizen and WebAssembly. A follow-up sync also fixes a CoreText typeface stream race on Apple platforms.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() to compute conservative paint bounds, including stroke, path effect, mask filter, and image filter expansion, before using SKCanvas.QuickReject().

bullets.lead: Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes
bullets.detail: Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() with tile-mode and input-filter overloads, plus SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty() for an explicit transparent-black node.
Adds SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() to turn SKOverdrawCanvas counts into a configurable six-color heat map for rendering diagnostics.

bullets.lead: Small-sigma raster blurs regain their fast path
bullets.detail: Avoids the slow raster-pipeline Gaussian path across native builds, substantially improving CPU image-filter blur performance without changing output.
SKSurface.Canvas now reuses its managed wrapper across calls while safely recreating it after explicit disposal, removing repeated interop and handle-lookup overhead in draw loops.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Completed the v4 obsolete-API transition, restored fast small-sigma raster blurs, and optimized repeated SKSurface.Canvas access

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update while retaining native platform support for PDF and current Windows graphics APIs.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.summary: Completes the v4 obsolete-API transition, removes the deprecated .NET Interactive integration, and updates bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds paint fast bounds, image filter crop and empty nodes, and overdraw visualization. It also restores fast small-sigma raster blurs, caches surface canvas wrappers, and fixes an Apple typeface race.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with fixes for AAT and Arabic shaping, COLR v1 rendering, glyph extents, font subsetting, and kana script mapping.
